messages.subject: Maps of Australia in ggplot2
parts:
I converted the ozRegion() data to a data frame that can be directly
used in ggplot2. This allows one to make maps of Australia in ggplot2.
See www.elaliberte.info/software<http://www.elaliberte.info/software>
for files and examples. Perhaps someone else had done this before, but
if so I couldn't find it. Anyway, hope the data frame is helpful to
some.
